headline: ピキサントロンは脱塩基部位と結合し、2種類の異性体を生じる
subhead: NMR構造では、どちらの異性体もDNAに挿入され、向かいのシトシンを押し出す

summary.question: ピキサントロンは、DNAの脱塩基部位と2種類の位置異性体を作ると予想された。
summary.approach: NMRに基づく分子動力学計算で構造を求め、結晶構造も決めた。
summary.result: 二本鎖では異性体R aが優勢で、どちらも3′側にインターカレートした。
summary.learned: 向かいのシトシンとの水素結合が、生成比と挿入の深さの違いを説明しうる。

question.quote: The nitrogen atom in the PIX aza-anthracenedione ring renders the two side-chain amines nonequivalent, and predicts the formation of regioisomeric Schiff base conjugates with AP sites in DNA, referred to as regioisomers A and B and designated as R a and R b (Chart ).

approach.quote: Structures of reduced R a and R b conjugates from molecular dynamics calculations restrained by 1H NOESY data in 5′-d­(C1A2G3A4C5T6 X 7A8G9A10C11T12)-3′:5′-d­(A13G14T15C16T17C18A19G20T21C22T23G24)-3′, X = reduced PIX-AP site conjugate, showed that both regioisomers intercalated on the 3′ side of base pair T6/A19, displacing C18 into the major groove, with R a less intercalated than R b.
A crystal structure in the Dickerson-Drew Dodecamer at 2.5 Å resolution revealed looped-out PIX stacking with PIX from a neighboring duplex.

result.quote: In dsDNA formation of R a was favored.

Structures of reduced R a and R b conjugates from molecular dynamics calculations restrained by 1H NOESY data in 5′-d­(C1A2G3A4C5T6 X 7A8G9A10C11T12)-3′:5′-d­(A13G14T15C16T17C18A19G20T21C22T23G24)-3′, X = reduced PIX-AP site conjugate, showed that both regioisomers intercalated on the 3′ side of base pair T6/A19, displacing C18 into the major groove, with R a less intercalated than R b.

learned.quote: The preferential formation of R a vs R b in dsDNA and deeper intercalation of R b may be explained by the differential ability of the asymmetric PIX N2 nitrogen in R a vs R b to hydrogen bond with the exocyclic N 4-amine of the cytosine displaced into the major groove.

highlights.text: 一本鎖ではR aとR bが1:1で生成するが、二本鎖では0 °Cで約1.8:1とR aが優勢で、Tm以上の60 °Cでは約1.1:1に戻る。著者は対向するシトシンとの水素結合が関与する速度論的な説明を「確定した機構ではなく妥当な解釈」とする。

evidence.quote: Significantly, in ssDNA containing an AP site, where the complementary cytosine C18 is absent, both regioisomers R a and R b form in equal proportions.
This represents one possible interpretation based on NMR-derived structural evidence and should be viewed as a plausible explanation rather than a definitive mechanistic conclusion.

highlights.text: 還元型PIX–AP部位コンジュゲートは、AP部位を模すTHF入り二本鎖（Tm 37.2 °C）より10.4 °C安定化したが、無修飾二本鎖（58.8 °C）よりは11.2 °C低い。AP部位を完全には修復できない。

This resulted in a 10.4 °C increase in the T m

highlights.text: 結晶構造ではPIXはインターカレートせず、隣の二本鎖のPIXと積み重なって外側に反転していた。NMR溶液構造の挿入型と異なる。

evidence.quote: the pixantrone (PIX) moieties do not intercalate into the DNA as traditionally expected; instead, they are flipped relative to one another in an extrahelical orientation

lab_notes.construct: ウラシル入りの12量体をUDGで処理してAP部位化し、ピキサントロンとNaBH3CNで還元型コンジュゲートを作製。
lab_notes.purification: 逆相HPLC（C18）後、相補鎖とアニールしてヒドロキシアパタイトで精製し、Sephadex G-25で脱塩。
lab_notes.sample_prep: NMRは300 µM二本鎖、100 mM NaCl、10 mM NaH2PO4（pH 7.0）。結晶は1 mM DNAでハンギングドロップ蒸気拡散。
lab_notes.data_collection: NMRは900 MHz、NOESY 250 ms、288 K。X線はAPSのLS-CAT 21-ID-Dで測定し、Br-SADで位相決定。

evidence.quote: Escherichia coli uracil-DNA glycosylase (UDG; EC 3.2.2.3; New England Biolabs; Ipswich, MA) (0.25 units/μL) was added to the uracil-containing dodecamer
The duplex dodecamer containing the reduced PIX-AP site conjugate was passed over a hydroxyapatite (HAP) column
The concentrations of dodecamer duplexes were 300 μM.
The hanging drop vapor diffusion technique was used.
The structure was phased by Br-SAD using Phenix Autosol
